basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas. I grew up playing video games and have a particular fondness for the Gears of War series. When I'm not gaming, I'm usually tinkering with my Funko collection or spending time with my two kids and wife, who I met in college. I work from home, which gives me the flexibility to game during lunch breaks and late evenings. I'm currently exploring the dynamics of open relationships as my wife and I consider new aspects of our marriage.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in computer science and have been working in software development for over a decade. My expertise in technology and gaming systems comes from both formal education and years of personal interest. I often troubleshoot tech issues and share my findings with the online community.
